exposure: Labor induction with a PGE2 vaginal insert
Indications for induction (maternal, hypertensive disorders, premature rupture of membranes, fetal)
cohort: 1066 women with viable term singleton pregnancies who underwent labor induction with a PGE2 vaginal insert in 2013-2014
finding: The indication for labor induction was found to impact its failure rate, with maternal indications being significantly associated with induction failure in both nulliparous and multiparous women.
